blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said that she is yet to be formally summoned by the Senate impeachment court, requiring her to personally attend her trial. Duterte said her appearance ‘depends’ as there are no formal summons yet. Her remarks were made after she was informed regarding the House prosecutor’s intent
